summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VELO ETF (VELL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Velo3D, Inc. (TICKER: VELO), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements VELL was launched on Jun 4, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.

data.title: Defiance Launches VELL: The First Daily 2X Long ETF for Velo3D, Inc.
